summary: Frontend-only test of Admin App Management APK delete flow. Logged in via 'Login as Admin' quick button, navigated to /admin?tab=app_mgmt. Verified Customer App tab showed 'Uploaded · app.azoapp.homeservice · v1.0.0' status with a red trash Delete button next to Upload/Replace APK. Clicked Delete (window.confirm auto-accepted): DELETE /api/app-mgmt/admin/apk/customer returned 200, status flipped to 'No APK uploaded yet', and the Delete button disappeared (only Upload button remained). Repeated on Partner tab (data-testid=appmgmt-tab-partner): Delete button visible, click → DELETE /api/app-mgmt/admin/apk/partner returned 200, status became 'No APK uploaded yet', Delete button hidden. Full page reload confirmed persistence — both tabs still show 'No APK uploaded yet'. All acceptance criteria met.
test_credentials: Admin quick login button on /login (phone +919000000000 / OTP 123456)
seed_data_creation: Not required — both platforms pre-seeded with dummy APK by main agent
context_for_next_testing_agent: APK delete flow works end-to-end for both Customer and Partner apps. Note: to re-run this test, main agent must re-seed a dummy APK for both platforms (otherwise Delete buttons will not appear).
